metadata.description: Public agent skills and plugins by vcth4nh

plugins.name: retrospect
plugins.description: Retrospective over your past Claude Code sessions — parallel subagents mine each transcript for your corrections, recurring failure patterns, workflow friction, and wins, then reconcile everything into a report plus approved CLAUDE.md updates — or hunt one specific recurring instruction across your history with a topic argument — in this project, another project, or all of them. One skill, one agent, read-only until you approve.

plugins.name: codex-exec
plugins.description: Consult OpenAI Codex as a discussion peer — second opinions and multi-turn debate via codex exec/resume, delegation only when trusted. One skill, no scripts, no hooks, no state.

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Remove AI-slop tone from prose. Two skills: deslop for engineering prose (docs, commits, PRs, READMEs) and academic-voice for paper prose with per-repo voice matching. Ships an opt-in Claude Code ASD-STE100 output style.

plugins.name: public-hygiene
plugins.description: Check public-facing text before it ships. leak-check finds internal-context leaks (local paths, run IDs, infra names, private provenance, dev-log narrative, unexpanded jargon) and sends high-stakes text to a fresh subagent reviewer with a BLOCK/PASS verdict. cold-read finds context the audience lacks (terms nobody introduced, numbers without a base, unclear referents, unattributed quotes), applies separate standards to slides and documents, and asks the author for the missing facts.
